notes: These generated virtual-microphone checks validate software integration, not physical microphone fidelity or data-center sound attribution.
The frozen classifier, DSP, quality gates, opaque model payloads and community API/schema were not modified. No model inference, training, community publication or audio upload was requested.

The first local Sources assertion preceded committed navigation. It was corrected to wait for the heading. A following hash navigation retained the existing observation, so a fresh reload preceded the final clean local run.
The first read-only API smoke request used unsupported parameter names and was rejected. The final check uses the client's documented lat/lon/radiusKm/limit query and returned HTTP 200.
